title: DreamCo Institute 100-Resource Foundry and Bootcamp Reference Library
purpose: Reference map for original DreamCo-authored curricula, architectures, engineering patterns, evaluation and integrations.

policy.fetch_policy: No automated fetching or bulk download from this catalog.
policy.quarantine_policy: External source bytes remain quarantined until exact revision, license, terms, provenance, privacy and training permissions are reviewed.
policy.clean_room_output: Independently author original DreamCo blueprints, exercises, tests and synthetic examples; do not copy protected expression, code, weights or datasets.
policy.benchmark_policy: Never import benchmark answer keys into training; maintain independent private holdouts.
